title: CA runtime expiry bypass when clock pre-epoch
description: verify_and_extract_cn computes now_secs via ASN1Time::now().timestamp() (wraps OffsetDateTime::now_utc().unix_timestamp()). If the system clock is set before 1970-01-01, unix_timestamp() returns a negative i64. The guard 'now_secs > issuer.not_after_secs' then evaluates false for any CA with not_after_secs > 0, bypassing the runtime expiry check and allowing an expired CA to authenticate leaf certs. Fix: assert now_secs > 0 before the loop, or use saturating comparison that treats a pre-epoch clock as expired.
